sector.narrative: Media and free flow of information

description.narrative: For results, see previous statements, in particular the CoP from 18 May 2015. Results and achievements mentioned include: - key publications, for instance a booklet ‘Access to Information – examining progress in Africa’, providing a basic assessment on the state of access to information in 14 countries. - direct lobbying and advocacy of national governments and institutions, multilateral institutions and intergovernmental bodies e.g SADC secretariat, ACHPR, Pan African Parliament and UN Human Rights Council for progressive policies that promote media freedom and freedom of expression. - direct assistance to journalists undergoing persecution in their home countries.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
